package plantedsplit

func fillNested(h holder) { h.d.Code = "planted_split_nested" }

func fillEmbedded(w *wrapped) { w.Code = "planted_split_embedded" }

func fillEmbeddedSelector(o outerWrap) { o.inner.Code = "planted_split_embedded_selector" }

func fillPromoted(w wrapped) { w.DetailedError.Code = "planted_split_promoted" }
